question: B is the mother of A. C is the sister of A’s father D. E is the brother of C. How is B related to E?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf9WrMX2PxUUiuc23xtLzIYfAm-irKB4b57QlaLQLGdZfRiZezLGmE-LDNzE8Cwo2irGS7CWeUw-nY5zMYIdWPZre6UsWnYjv1MpUAVRhIwEu2rYK0rb8Zv1_QSlVCu5fvDClEGTgVIIgUmbHNzoyQcd8-5?key=Pg8w9VmbvKrHmQxFZbtW-g] 

Given:

1) B is the mother of A.

2) C is the sister of A’s father D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/806d96d9945803416cca6f0f8dc07ba4a32b9d37ba255f3a1f3cd77256a5835c.png] 

3) E is the brother of C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1a1e2b619810f4ef726ba0ee9eebb46a1516108b2f59e66b7eaf2dc1476f79e.png]
